title: Report units by category
prompt: For every category that has at least one product, return category (its name), products (how many products it has) and units (the total quantity of those products across all order items). A product that never sold still counts as a product and adds 0 units. Put the most units first, and sort categories with the same units by category.
hints: Some products have no order items. Which join keeps them?
After joining products to their items, a product appears once per item. Count each product once.
JOIN products, then LEFT JOIN order_items. count(DISTINCT p.id) AS products, COALESCE(sum(i.quantity), 0) AS units

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses an inner join to the items, which drops products that never sold.
Counts joined rows and reports them as products.

feedback: Test one category with a plain query on products alone: how many products does it have?
